paragraphs.text: The City Guard of Paliano on Fiora is the former protective force of King Brago . It was led by Captain Adriana Vallore .

After Brago 's second death and Marchesa 's usurpation, the guard was thrown over in favor of troops loyal only to Marchesa, and many were imprisoned. Adriana rebelled and staged some daring rescues to bring her former guards to her side.
The symbol of the rebel Guard is a depiction of the hilt of Brago 's sword.
